target.description: Absolute target directory path for the bootstrapped system

mirror.description: Mirror URL: http://, https://, file:///, or ssh://

arch.description: Target architecture (e.g., 'amd64', 'arm64'). Required only if dpkg is unavailable

variant.description: Bootstrap variant: 'minbase', 'buildd', or 'fakechroot'. Empty means default (required+important packages)

include.description: Additional packages to install (comma-separated in output)

exclude.description: Packages to omit (⚠️ avoid essential packages)

no_check_sig.description: Disable OpenPGP signature checking for Release files

cache_dir.description: Absolute path for caching downloaded .deb files

foreign.description: Perform only initial unpack phase for cross-architecture bootstrapping

unpack_tarball.description: Absolute path to gzipped tarball of .debs (instead of downloading)

make_tarball.description: Path to write gzipped tarball of downloaded .debs

print_debs.description: Print list of packages to be installed and exit

log_extra_deps.description: Record additional resolved dependencies in debootstrap.log

private_key.description: Path to client PEM private key

debian_installer.description: Internal flag for use by debian-installer

inrelease_path.description: Custom path to InRelease file relative to standard location
